# A8 inert preparation debrief

Author: `/root/otto_review_14_17`, explicitly reassigned as preparation worker under Otto. Prior14/17 reviews confer no independent-review status on this authored A8 candidate.

ACK observed2026-09-17T02:42:19.387Z; first checkpoint22:52:19EDT, original A8 promise not reset. Local preparation START02:47:54.035Z followed durable ticket/checklist/FIRE readback. Oddkit planning→execution PASS4/4 at02:47:59.682Z preceded authorship. Earlier narrow DO NOT FIRE and subsequent binding/checklist corrections remain in the rail as history, not retroactively cured.

## What changed and why

Five new preparation files make the accepted topology correction concrete without modifying runnable configuration or product code. README carries the gated sequence and owner boundaries; evidence inventory separates direct Git observations from attributed provider receipts and current schemas; request descriptions intentionally cannot be applied; the JSON is an inert domain proposal with null unknowns; this debrief carries evidence and return requirements.

The active source still contains the old topology. That defect is not fixed by these documents. A later actual correction PR must reconcile active configuration and policy/docs together and pass its own integration gates.

## Author checks — not independent acceptance

Baseline:10f5f444d68475d7114ab8fe0bf269fe106476b1. Local structural checks compare every pre-existing tracked file's bytes to that exact Git blob, require exactly the five allowed new paths, parse the domain JSON, require all unresolved inputs null and every readiness boolean false, verify distinct proposed Worker names and branches, and reject deploy invocations/provider executable bodies. A later hash manifest and exact local commit identify this candidate for independent review; no repository runtime test suite is credited to this documentation-only preparation.

No active config/runtime test or selector dry-run was executed: there is no runnable staging config here, and provider behavior/IDs are missing. No Cloudflare execute call, account mutation, Worker upload, resource/secret operation, data action, shared-branch push, merge or deployment was performed. GitHub account ruleset was read only. Local commit is review cargo, not a landed product or independent PASS.

## Unknowns and return

Staging IDs/tag/audience, repository and build-token associations, candidate-dependent bindings, secret channel and trigger side effects remain UNKNOWN. Current Cloudflare account state was not re-observed by this worker. See the evidence inventory and null field list; schema alone cannot close them.

Otto must route the exact candidate to a fresh independent reviewer, preserve actual author/reviewer identity and all future resource/integration gates, and disposition any AMEND before creating an executable successor. Root owns journal/reconciliation persistence. The author cannot accept this candidate or claim whole A8 done.

Cookbook impact: under Chris's13c5707710339 requirement, full closure requires a maintained accepted operational recipe in the cookbook paired with the accepted app revision, external-resource and secret-name/channel declarations without secret values, and independent rebuild verification. This app-local proposal neither updates that cookbook recipe nor proves full reproducibility; return that source update to the cookbook owner with the eventual accepted implementation. App-only fixes remain incomplete until cookbook sync.

docs/release/a8-preparation/README.md.content:
# A8 topology correction — inert preparation

**DO NOT APPLY. This directory is a proposal, not deployable configuration or permission to act.** It changes no active application file. Unknown resource identifiers remain null in the companion domain description. That JSON is neither a Wrangler file nor an API request body. No deployment commands or runnable provider requests are included.

The current app baseline is `10f5f444d68475d7114ab8fe0bf269fe106476b1`; main is the empty `895339fb5a289b357148e7050447125791e6a411`. Current source maps phase-0/walking-skeleton to DEV and main to production. The intended correction is main→isolated staging, followed by a separately authorized main→production-branch promotion. The existing main-to-production mapping is a defect, not an approved shortcut.

Authority: existing kitchen A8 ticket, accepted amendment e319df1, independent preparation-plan review [5707515562](https://github.com/klappy/3d-review-app/pull/3#issuecomment-5707515562), narrow ticket0f59072, checklist6e66a322 and FIRE ac4746f6. Otto issued this worker START at2026-09-17T02:47:54.035Z for these five inert files only. Full A8 is not fired or accepted. Its historical ninety-minute promise and promotion hold remain unchanged.

## Proposed transition sequence

1. **Prepare a real candidate and its inputs.** Establish actual staging Worker tag, independent D1, Access audience, repository/build-token associations and a non-disclosing secret channel under separately reviewed orders. Verify provider creation behavior, especially whether trigger creation can start a build. Produce runnable configuration only after actual identifiers and prerequisites are known. Preserve existing DEV and production state; do not copy their persistent state into staging. Existing auth/rate-limit changes are separate candidates, not assumed dependencies or silently integrated work.
2. **Gate and deliver the correction to DEV.** The isolated correction PR into phase-0/walking-skeleton is a real DEV deployment through its existing Git hook. Require independent exact-diff acceptance, real current-head Cursor Bugbot SUCCESS, all attached checks terminal, resolved findings and a prospective disposition limited to this correction. Re-observe source, selector, build command, bindings/secret names, active versions and queued builds. Exclude migrations and seed replay against existing data. Review a compatible Git-hook code/config rollback before integration. Read back resulting Git/build/version/bindings/health; this becomes the post-correction DEV baseline. Failure stops later main/staging work.
3. **Remove accidental production-from-main before any main update.** Preserve current trigger/build/deployment observations. Use a narrowly reviewed production-only bootstrap protection: retain PR/update/deletion/force protections, exempt only the required-check-on-creation barrier for the new production ref, and leave main/phase0 protection untouched. Create production at the exact empty-main ancestry; tighten creation protection immediately and verify effective rules before attaching a trigger. Retarget only the existing production trigger's branch filter to production. Inspect and drain identified old-main queued/running builds under their explicit order; unexpected activity stops main writes. Rejection never permits broader protection relaxation. Safe rollback must not reconnect production to main after main contains application code.
4. **Establish isolated staging delivery.** A new staging Worker, independent D1 and Access application, independent secrets and all candidate-required bindings must be ready. Only reviewed migrations may initialize the new empty D1; existing DEV/production databases are untouched. Add a main-only staging Git trigger against the actual Worker tag and existing repository connection only after initial-build behavior is established and safe. Preserve the existing DEV trigger. The proposed selector is the staging environment of the root Wrangler file; an environment name alone is not isolation proof.
5. **Gate PR3 into main/staging.** Independently review the whole exact baseline, reconcile actual delivered scope and findings, require literal exact-head Bugbot SUCCESS and terminal checks, and record a candidate-specific promotion-hold disposition. Observe that promotion review is comment-only in actual Bugbot behavior, not merely in prose. A normal protected merge activates only the authorized staging hook. Read back commit, build, deployment, manifest-derived version stamp, bindings/Access and actual API/MCP and applicable UX evidence. DEV must match the post-correction baseline; production must remain unchanged.
6. **Production remains separate.** Only the separately reviewed and captain-authorized main→production promotion may ship production. It needs its own manifest bump/changelog/stamp and checks, successful staging evidence, data preflight and production readback. This directory grants none of that authority.

## File and owner boundaries

Only this directory's README, PROVIDER-EVIDENCE, REQUEST-DESCRIPTIONS, STAGING-PROPOSAL and DEBRIEF are candidate cargo. Existing `wrangler.toml`, `package.json`, release runbook, `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` and every runtime file remain byte-identical to the baseline.

Future corrections to those active documentation/configuration surfaces must be delivered together in their executable correction PR; this proposal does not claim the stale active runbook or Bugbot note is fixed. Any runtime/version-display hunk in `src/index.ts`, staff/agent auth, contracts, handlers, migrations, seeds, reports or Design returns to its actual owner. Do not interpret this order as a transfer of the native auth12/15 pen.

Chris's [delivery-sequence ruling](https://github.com/klappy/3d-review-cookbook/issues/13#issuecomment-5707616351) requires fully functional MCP/API and full source-backed design coverage before broad UI implementation. This infrastructure preparation supplies neither acceptance. Participant shared-survey correction and backend/design gaps remain with their owners.

## How this proposal will be judged

A fresh independent reviewer must inspect the five-file diff, prove all pre-existing tracked files unchanged, distinguish schema knowledge from runtime observations, verify every unknown remains blocked, and assess the proposed sequence against the accepted order. Author structural checks are evidence for that review, not independent acceptance. No remote persistence or product merge follows automatically from local preparation.

## Cookbook update and reproducible rebuild return

Chris's [rebuild requirement](https://github.com/klappy/3d-review-cookbook/issues/13#issuecomment-5707710339) requires the app to be reliably reconstructable from the maintained cookbook. This proposal is app-local preparation only; it is not the accepted operational recipe or a rebuild demonstration.

Return the accepted A8 operational sequence, actual configuration decisions, candidate/revision pins, external-resource declarations and secret-name/channel requirements to the responsible cookbook owner, paired with the reviewed app revision. Never record secret values. Full A8 closure requires that cookbook synchronization and independent rebuild verification under its bounded order; an app-only topology fix cannot close it. Resource IDs are declared external dependencies with custody and freshness, not silently assumed reproducible local state. This candidate does not claim that the entire app or its infrastructure can already be rebuilt from the cookbook.

# Future request descriptions — DO NOT APPLY

These are review questions and field-level intentions, **not API bodies, scripts or authorization**. They intentionally omit complete mutation payloads and executable commands. Read current schemas and actual resources again when an independently reviewed execution order exists.

| Future action | Intended minimal change | Preconditions and required readback |
|---|---|---|
| Production branch bootstrap protection | New ruleset scoped only to refs/heads/production; retain PR, deletion and non-fast-forward protections. Limit temporary required-status exemption to branch creation. | Prove exact schema and effective rules; preserve main/phase0 rules and bypass list. Create only at verified empty895339fb ancestry, tighten creation exemption immediately, inspect protection before trigger attachment. An API refusal stops this substep; no general rule weakening. |
| Detach erroneous production-from-main | Existing production trigger's branch inclusion becomes production only. | Capture full trigger fields and active/queued builds. Preserve all other fields. Verify old-main build drain before any main population; cancelling any actual old-main build requires its own identified reviewed order. Any unexpected production activity stops main writes. Never restore prod→main after main contains app code. |
| Create staging Worker metadata | Separate named3d-review-staging Worker, without source/version upload. | Resolve actual creation schema/readOnly ambiguity and secret lifecycle first. Verify returned Worker ID/tag and deployed_on. No script/version bootstrap or manual deployment substitute. |
| Create staging D1 | New independent3d-review-staging database. | Approved resource/cost scope, fresh returned ID, prove distinct from DEV/prod. Initialize only the new empty database with reviewed migrations under a separate data order; no seed or migration replay against existing databases. |
| Create staging Access application | Separate staff OTP return surface at staging host/v2/auth/access, with its own audience and reviewed policy. | Auth owner reviews path/policy; resolve application schema, actual ID/audience and non-disclosing secret channel. This is staff entry; it does not restore participant login/codes or alter the shared-survey ruling. |
| Associate independent secrets | Establish new staging SESSION_SECRET and CODE_ESCROW_SECRET through approved non-disclosing channel. | Names only in review; independent values, no DEV/prod reuse, verify presence without revealing values. A missing channel is a named execution gap. |
| Add main-only staging Git trigger | Associate actual staging Worker tag, repository connection and reviewed build-token association; explicit staging selector, reviewed typecheck/tests build and path filters. | Before creation, prove/contain initial-build behavior. Resources, bindings, guards and secrets must be ready for any first deployment. Verify exact readback and absence of unintended DEV/prod build changes; no manual build dispatch. |

Current provider fields and unresolved inputs are catalogued in PROVIDER-EVIDENCE.md and STAGING-PROPOSAL.json. No row is executable or accepted merely because its API exists.

## Future active-file correction, outside this candidate

Reconcile wrangler's environment map, release/deploy documentation, AGENTS release binding, promotion Bugbot policy and applicable ruleset artifacts in the same correction PR. Preserve DEV/prod settings and state; use actual staging identifiers, no placeholders. Send any `src/index.ts`/runtime stamp change to its real owner. An active-file correction needs separate exact-diff review, local selector/guard verification under a proven read-only method, literal Bugbot SUCCESS, terminal attached checks, and a prospective limited DEV disposition before merge. Whole-baseline PR3/staging and production each retain their later independent gates.

## Failure responses

- Unknown input or contradictory source: retain null/UNKNOWN and return to Otto; do not invent a value.
- A request can run or a proposal enters active configuration: stop preparation and return AMEND to the scoped owner.
- Provider mutation fails during a future order: retain refusal evidence; never expand protection exceptions or substitute script uploads.
- Wrong target, shared state, unexpected production build or data replay: stop downstream main writes and use the reviewed safe rollback boundary. Database reset is not a rollback option.
